8	- **Broadcast Messaging**: Send messages to all connected clients

18	### NotificationServer Class

24	- `broadcast(message)`: Send message to all clients

33	- Cleans up disconnected clients

44	{

46	  "payload": {},
47	  "timestamp": "2023-01-01T00:00:00.000000"
